newsitem.title: UK: Credit Card group Visa launches new UK ad campaign.
newsitem.headline: Credit Card group Visa launches new UK ad campaign.

text.p: Credit card company, Visa International, has produced a new national television advertising campaign to promote its leading debit card, it said on Thursday.
The campaign, which breaks on September 16, will light-heartedly sing the virtues of using a 'Visa Delta' card to buy goods rather than cash.
The TV drive will be supported by a national poster campaign next month. Saatchi & Saatchi, who created the advertising, said the TV commercials would have a 'Vaudeville-like' feel to them.
British comedian Mel Smith will feature in the ads.
Overall, the aim is to raise consumer awareness.

"Our tracking research shows a growing understanding of the use of debit as a cheque replacement, but consumers are less aware that Visa Delta can be used in more places than any other debit card,"Fiona Wilkinson, general manager Visa UK Ltd said.
